This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 47/2023, registered at Police Station-Kamla Nagar, Bhopal, District Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 376(3)/109,
328 and 342 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 16 and 17 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 26.01.2023.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has been examined and she is hostile in Court.

sentences.text: , applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant is having criminal antecedents of 27 cases.

In these circumstances,
applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the fact that prosecutrix has been examined in Court, she is hostile and the fact that applicant is in jail since 26.01.2023, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed on following conditions :-
1. Applicant will mark his presence before local police station twice (1st and 15th)
every month till completion of trial.
2 . If applicant is found involved in any other offence in future during bail then bail granted to applicant shall stand automatically cancelled and he will be committed to custody in this crime number.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on aforesaid condition on furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
